statement: The five-node formation certification analyzer (scripts/checks/formation-release-handoff-gcp-analysis.js, the single owner of generation classification and closure verdicts) classifies a generation whose last recorded state is active at the seed's draining marker but which never completed as the DISTINCT typed outcome GENERATION_CLASSIFICATION.RETAINED_UNCOMPLETED_AT_TEARDOWN with its own failing invariant noRetainedUncompletedAtTeardown, so run 2026-08-30T07-13-07.175Z (generation e1:4 retained active at teardown) is refused instead of certified, while teardown_truncated keeps its sealed prior semantics; completionMs covers every captured generation and is null (never a partial number) while any generation is stranded or retained-uncompleted; an active terminal without a draining marker stays stranded (fail-closed); nothing derives cluster ACTIVE or READY from nodes.status, publication counts, or coverage. Proven deterministically on an immutable excerpt of the 07-13-07 run: red on HEAD (certified), green after.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
The closure analyzer remains the single owner of generation classification and closure verdicts; no other script mints a pass/fail of its own.

Nothing derives cluster ACTIVE or READY from nodes.status, publication counts, or coverage; READY is only the owner's recorded readyNodeIds, and unattributable retention (no draining marker) fails closed as stranded.

Every outcome is a typed GENERATION_CLASSIFICATION constant with its own invariant; completionMs is null rather than a partial number while any captured generation never completed; teardown_truncated keeps its sealed prior semantics.

Proof is a deterministic witness over an immutable excerpt of run 2026-08-30T07-13-07.175Z, red on HEAD (certified) and green after, with unchanged controls that must stay green; no cloud run is part of the proof.
